description: This file contains implementation of debugging utilities for Android, including functions to determine debug levels from properties and strings, and to manage experiment flags.

methods.name: ADebug::GetLevelFromSettingsString
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string to determine debug level for a given name.

methods.name: ADebug::GetLevelFromProperty
methods.description: Retrieves debug level setting from system property.

methods.name: ADebug::GetDebugLevelFromProperty
methods.description: Returns debug level as enum based on property value.

methods.name: ADebug::GetDebugName
methods.description: Generates a debug name by removing specific terms from input string.

methods.name: ADebug::getExperimentFlag
methods.description: Determines if an experiment flag should be enabled based on properties and serial number.
